description.p: Rusty Solitaire is a collection of 91 solitaire card games, including Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Golf, Yukon and Scorpion. It is a Rust port of GNOME AisleRiot and plays every game by AisleRiot's original rules.

ul.li: Hints, unlimited undo and redo, and game options for each game
Drag and drop, click to move, or play with the keyboard
Statistics for each game, sound effects, and the rules of every game built in

description.p: Credits for everyone who made GNOME AisleRiot, in the help and the About box.
Statistics, sounds, keyboard play, a keyboard shortcuts window, and the rules of every game in the Help menu.
Credits now name "The Rusty Solitaire authors"; new application ID io.github.rustysolitaire.RustySolitaire.
